title: Average EMF calculation
description: Essential: Correctly calculates average induced EMF using Faraday's law: E = -ΔΦ/Δt, with ΔΦ = BΔS.

title: Average current determination
description: Essential: Correctly computes average induced current using Ohm's law: I = E/R.

title: Total charge calculation
description: Essential: Correctly determines total charge using q = IΔt or q = ΔΦ/R.

title: Magnetic flux change
description: Important: Recognizes that pulling sides together reduces area to zero, so ΔΦ = B × initial area.

title: Sign convention handling
description: Important: Applies Faraday's law correctly, though absolute value may be used for magnitude questions.

title: Unit consistency
description: Optional: Maintains consistent SI units throughout calculations and includes units in final answers.

title: Area misinterpretation
description: Pitfall: Incorrectly assumes constant area or uses wrong area change (e.g., half instead of zero).

title: Formula misapplication
description: Pitfall: Uses instantaneous EMF formula (E = -dΦ/dt) instead of average (E = -ΔΦ/Δt) for constant Δt.
